antenna.note: rover path = master path shifted by +12.44 m in s (lateral |offset| < 5 cm median); rover pose ~ pose(s + 12.44); midpoint ~ pose(s + 6.22)

frame.axes: x=east, y=north, z=up [m]; local tangent plane at origin
frame.s: horizontal arc length in the ENU plane = true ground distance (rel. error < 1e-6)
frame.yaw: rad, ENU convention (0 = east, CCW positive), direction of travel

utm.note: utm_e/utm_n columns; UTM grid scale ~0.99972 and convergence ~-1.28 deg here

topology.note: tram is unidirectional; every edge is traversed in increasing s. main is a closed cycle; branches are alternatives attached to main at from.s (diverge) / to.s (merge); from/to = null: yard end (end of observed data)

edges.description: closed cycle: east platform -> east loop -> WB main -> west yard/loop -> fan F1 -> EB main -> east platform

sections.name: east_loop_departure
sections.note: east platform -> east terminal loop -> WB start

sections.name: west_yard_loop
sections.note: west junction -> arrival stop -> west loop -> fan track F1

sections.name: east_loop_arrival
sections.note: east approach -> east terminal platform (s = L = 0)

stops_note: stop = GNSS speed < 0.1 m/s for >= 5 s; s = median master-antenna position of the cluster; cls: platform (P(stop|pass)>=0.5, robust std<=3 m, dwell>=8 s), signal (repeated, >=3 runs), terminal (run start/end layover), random. landmark = n_runs>=3 and robust std<=1 m -> usable as along-track fix when the wheels report standstill near it.

wheel_calibration_hint.model: ds_map = ds_wheel * (1 + c0 + c_abs*|k(s)| + c_signed*k(s)), ds_wheel = wheel km/h / 3.6 * dt
wheel_calibration_hint.data: cruising 10 s windows (|a|<0.15 m/s^2), RTK fixes on main, train+val: 880 windows, 61.9 km

validation.note: val runs vs train-only map (map_train); see REPORT.md
